name: Mikawa (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Mikawa town emblem in yellow: three interlocking loops forming a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Mikawa, a town in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 January 1965.

features.role: Mikawa town emblem — three interlocking loops forming a stylised character
